goalZh: 会用 I can… / Can you…? 分工,说清楚活动的日期和时间
canDoZh: 能和朋友一起计划一次活动:定日期和时间、分工、保密

newItems.noteZh: 宿舍楼、酒店里的公共休息室;ou 读 /aʊ/,结尾 ge 读 /dʒ/。
bake a cake(烤蛋糕);和 cake 押韵 /eɪk/,词尾 k 收住不加元音。
a 读 /æ/,嘴张大;snacks and juice(零食和果汁)。
ui 读长音 /uː/,词尾是清音 /s/;orange juice(橙汁)。
重音在前,结尾的 l 自成一个音节 “CAN-dl”;twenty candles(二十根蜡烛)。
重音在后 bal-LOON;拼写是两个 l、两个 o。
过去式 hid;i 读 /aɪ/,词尾 d 轻轻收住。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: OK, Sofia's surprise party! It's on Sunday, the 28th, at seven.
lines.zh: (12 月 26 日,三个人偷偷碰头)好,索菲亚的惊喜派对!定在 28 号星期天晚上七点。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: In the lounge in her building. I can bake a cake!
lines.zh: 在她那栋楼的休息室。蛋糕我来烤!

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: And I can play my guitar.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Great! Lei, can you get snacks and juice?
lines.zh: 太好了!磊,你能去买点零食和果汁吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sure. And twenty candles! She's going to be twenty.
lines.zh: 没问题。还要二十根蜡烛!她要满二十岁了。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yes! And balloons. Then we can hide in the lounge.
lines.zh: 对!还有气球。然后我们先藏在休息室里。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: But how is Sofia going to come to the lounge?
lines.zh: 可是索菲亚怎么会来休息室呢?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I can invite her to watch a movie. It's a movie night!
lines.zh: 我约她来看电影。就说是电影之夜!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Perfect! But it's a secret, OK?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: OK! Sunday at seven. It's a secret!

questions.prompt: 惊喜派对定在什么时候?
questions.explainZh: It's on Sunday, the 28th, at seven.(28 号星期天七点。)

options: 买零食、果汁和蜡烛,还要把索菲亚约到休息室
questions.explainZh: Lei, can you get snacks and juice? —— Sure. And twenty candles! …… I can invite her to watch a movie.(烤蛋糕的是艾米,弹吉他的是马库斯。)

questions.prompt: 他们打算怎么让索菲亚来休息室?
questions.explainZh: I can invite her to watch a movie. It's a movie night!

grammar.titleZh: 用 can 分工:I can… / Can you…?
grammar.bodyZh: 商量分工时,用 I can…(我来……)主动揽活,用 Can you…?(你能……吗?)请别人做:I can bake a cake. / Can you get snacks?(这里的 get 是“买来、弄来”)。回答:Sure. / Got it. / OK!。说活动时间,日子前用 on,钟点前用 at:on Sunday, the 28th, at seven;也可以先说钟点:at seven on Sunday。聚会、吃饭这类事,说 at seven 大家就知道是晚上七点。

examples.text: Can you get snacks and juice? — Sure.
examples.zh: 你能买点零食和果汁吗?——没问题。

examples.text: The party is on Sunday, the 28th, at seven.
examples.zh: 派对在 28 号星期天晚上七点。
